front: Stabilize a dying creature or stop a bleed on an adjacent creature with a Medicine check.
back:
Adjacent creature; if both dying and bleeding, choose one.
Stabilize: Medicine vs. DC 5 + recovery roll DC (typically 15 + dying value) on a creature at 0 HP and dying.
Stop Bleeding: Medicine vs. the DC of the effect that caused the bleed.
Success: stabilize: loses dying (stays unconscious); bleeding: assisted recovery with lowered DC.
Crit Failure: stabilize: dying value +1; bleeding: takes damage equal to its persistent bleed.
